title: Build 1 and 2: which way?
question: You picked The Order Slip and The Shop Counter. Build them as two product templates you can assign per product, or merge them into one page?

options.label: Both, as two templates
options.thesis: The Order Slip becomes the default product template; The Shop Counter becomes the second template, assignable per product in Shopify.
options.viewport: Each template keeps its own first viewport exactly as comped; both share the same variant, pack and add-to-bag behaviour underneath.
options.risk: Twice the build and review work, and two layouts to keep in step when the store changes.

options.label: One page, combined
options.thesis: The Order Slip's numbered flow, dressed with the Shop Counter's hanging price tag, jar-lid thumbnails and candy-box packs.
options.viewport: Photo stage with jar-lid thumbnails on the left; the paper slip on the right with the brass tag, lines 1 Your phone, 2 Style, 3 How many as candy boxes, and the red button with the total.
options.risk: A merge can blur both ideas; the slip must stay the one structure and the counter pieces only its parts.
